userStory.intent: publish, read, and pointer-advance semantic corpus artifacts by canonical content address under one bounded repository authority
userStory.outcome: exact bytes are retained once or matched idempotently without overwrite, reads verify digests without fallback, and pointer movement is one compare-and-swap permitted only after corpus closure

experience.statement: exact bytes are retained once or matched idempotently without overwrite, pointer movement, semantic interpretation, or mixed generation

given.text: one canonical artifact, declared artifact kind, expected digest, and bounded repository authority

when.text: the artifact is published atomically at its content address

then.text: exact bytes are retained once or matched idempotently without overwrite, pointer movement, semantic interpretation, or mixed generation

experience.statement: publication is rejected without overwrite, partial artifact, pointer movement, or reinterpretation of either digest

given.text: supplied bytes do not match the expected digest or an occupied content address contains different bytes

then.text: publication is rejected without overwrite, partial artifact, pointer movement, or reinterpretation of either digest

scenarios.name: Reject digest mismatch or occupied-address byte conflict

experience.statement: the exact artifact or an attributable missing, corrupted, or unauthorized finding is returned without fallback to current or latest state

given.text: one authorized artifact digest and bounded repository authority

when.text: the exact stored artifact is read and its digest and canonical form are verified

then.text: the exact artifact or an attributable missing, corrupted, or unauthorized finding is returned without fallback to current or latest state

scenarios.name: Read and verify one content-addressed artifact

experience.statement: its original bytes and digest are returned independently of the current pointer generation

given.text: a non-current snapshot digest is still referenced by a retained query, publication, or authoring receipt

when.text: that exact content address is read

then.text: its original bytes and digest are returned independently of the current pointer generation

scenarios.name: Read an older snapshot retained by receipt lineage

experience.statement: it advances exactly one generation or returns a conflict without changing any artifact, old pointer, or retained snapshot

given.text: one expected current digest, one published closed candidate snapshot, and a current closure receipt

when.text: the environment pointer is updated through one atomic compare-and-swap

then.text: it advances exactly one generation or returns a conflict without changing any artifact, old pointer, or retained snapshot

scenarios.name: Compare and swap the current pointer after corpus closure

experience.statement: the current pointer is unchanged and every missing, stale, or rejected subject is returned as an attributable finding

given.text: the candidate snapshot is missing, corrupted, open, rejected, or bound to a stale closure receipt

then.text: the current pointer is unchanged and every missing, stale, or rejected subject is returned as an attributable finding

scenarios.name: Reject a pointer update without current corpus closure

experience.statement: artifact digests and immutable address identities are identical without timestamp, machine, user, or path input

given.text: byte-identical canonical artifacts are published in different process and discovery orders

when.text: their content addresses and publication evidence are derived

then.text: artifact digests and immutable address identities are identical without timestamp, machine, user, or path input

scenarios.name: Reproduce one content address from identical canonical bytes

name: Operate a semantic corpus artifact repository

experience.promise: The projected capability either returns exact publication, read, or pointer evidence, or an attributable rejection with named findings; storage never changes semantic identity or meaning.

observableConditions.statement: repository authority reference and digest are admitted before any evaluation
supplied bytes must recompute the expected digest exactly; mismatched bytes are rejected without write
a content address occupied by different bytes rejects publication and mutates nothing
reads return the exact artifact or an attributable missing, corrupted, or unauthorized finding; no current or latest fallback
the pointer advances exactly one generation by compare-and-swap only when the candidate corpus closed; conflicts change no state
a scenario requiring an unadmitted mechanic returns a typed finding naming that mechanic and claims no publication, read, or pointer authority
